purpose: Durable structured extraction of the Architecture Steward session and cold-start handoff.
source_note: This is a structured extraction of the conversation's durable decisions, discoveries, process lessons, and repository state; it is not intended to be a verbatim transcript.

repository.name: BCP-dev
repository.access: The owner has full GitHub account access and agents should use it directly.

role.name: ARCHITECTURE_STEWARD
responsibilities: Maintain coherent architectural memory and documentation across domains.
Keep end vision, experience, architecture, evidence, implementation and proof connected without conflating them.
Give directions/protocols to peer agents when needed.
Act as policeman, tutor and hands-on architectural labor when useful.
Continuously simplify the operating process; overhead is a failure mode.

durable_decisions.statement: Do not redo strong destination research or archaeology merely to create a new structure; leverage and connect what already exists.
Assume roughly 80–90% of consequential design/build knowledge is already in the repository unless evidence shows otherwise. Default loop is FIND → SYNTHESIZE → DECIDE → BUILD → LEARN.
VIVIM is the Legos, not the Lego box. The product is a compositional factory/ecosystem and each user's resulting VIVIM instance is intentionally unique.

Ω is the current best real realization of the Lego factory. Earlier VIVIM variants are proven prototypes with mature behavior/UX/implementation intelligence but imperfect and often non-composable architecture.

Factory UX is the stable product target: discovery, addressing, understanding, composition, configuration, governance, inspection, creation, replacement, evolution and removal. One fixed instance UX is not canonical.

The factory alone is insufficient. A useful ecosystem also needs core compositional shapes/contracts, reference/first-party building blocks, useful compositions, interoperability standards by example, and ordinary-user creation of pieces and sets.
The Lego metaphor is conceptual only. Translate it into canonical VIVIM terms such as capability, plugin, composition, contract, object, surface, realization, authority, Work, Forge and evolution.
Building language does not imply K0. K0 remains narrow and constitutional; K1/shared contracts, system plugins, extension plugins and tooling handle progressively less-constitutional concerns.
User journeys are views, not the sole architectural spine. Composition is cross-cutting: USER OUTCOME × COMPOSABLE PIECES × GOVERNED COMPOSITION.
Prototype maturity, factory/core maturity and product-instance maturity are separate axes.
Subagents are bounded investigation tools, not a second management system. Every handoff must state prompt path, full repository URL, full GitHub access, mission and expected output.
Prior subagent artifacts are inputs, not automatic completion. A fresh takeover must re-read and challenge prior work before declaring a new round complete.
Parallelize genuinely independent investigations; use a single convergence pass when questions have become coupled; do not multiply process for ceremony.
Once coding-readiness is genuinely GO, stop broad architecture preparation. Implementation and falsification become the next information-bearing step.

The destination architecture graph is documentation-first and is anchored in END VISION → DESTINATION MODEL → HUMAN EXPERIENCE → CONCEPTUAL MODEL → RESPONSIBILITIES → JOURNEYS/REQUIREMENTS/VERTICAL SLICES → SYSTEM INTELLIGENCE/EVIDENCE → CURRENT ARCHITECTURAL MODEL.
Code is deliberately not in the initial destination architecture graph. Code, legacy implementation and proof are later evidence-bearing projections.

process_lessons: A prompt that describes a process is not enough; distinguish task-owner/orchestrator prompts from subagent-role prompts.
If prior artifacts exist, do not treat them as execution of the fresh task; treat them as evidence/history and require fresh bounded judgment when the task calls for a new round.
If a subagent execution facility is unavailable, never claim subagents ran; perform the bounded work directly and say so.

Missing process artifacts should not block useful work when the underlying mission, authority and evidence are sufficient; repair the process record later only if it materially improves future execution.
Do not build registries, trackers, views or automation merely because they might eventually be useful. Let repeated pain justify tooling.
The most valuable research pattern so far has been parallel independent lenses followed by hard convergence.
The main risk is not lack of knowledge; it is fragmentation, stale context, and agents silently reinterpretating the architecture during implementation.

readiness_history.note: Fresh takeover later re-grounded this work; the original dedicated launch prompt was absent, so execution was performed from stated mission plus current contracts rather than invented prompt contents.

fresh_readiness_findings.clarification: The first composition invokes a research capability, so that capability must be an explicit ordinary first-party plugin rather than implicit infrastructure.
fresh_readiness_findings.governed_path: Address → Intent → Context → Capability → Realization → Authority → Work → Execution → Evidence → World → Product Instance continuity
remaining_items: minimal State / Graph / Grant / Generation substrate
fresh_readiness_findings.interpretation: These are implementation/proof gates unless a concrete finding shows that one could force redesign of the factory boundary.

graph.current_interpretation: One semantic network with projections for responsibilities, dependencies, journeys, evidence, composition, etc.; not a pile of disconnected diagrams.
graph.next_expected_use: Finish/validate the graph itself, then use it to connect destination architecture to current Ω implementation, Legacy evidence and proof without making code the graph's source of truth.

architecture_graph_model.chain: END VISION → DESTINATION MODEL → HUMAN EXPERIENCE → CONCEPTUAL MODEL → RESPONSIBILITIES → JOURNEYS / REQUIREMENTS / VERTICAL SLICES → SYSTEM INTELLIGENCE / EVIDENCE → CURRENT ARCHITECTURAL MODEL
architecture_graph_model.important_principle: One underlying graph; many views. Do not create multiple competing master documents.

next_session_focus: Start from the fresh-session handoff, not from this chat.
Verify the graph branch and its four graph files against the destination corpus and current readiness evidence.
Determine whether the graph is structurally sufficient or needs only targeted repair.
Connect current Ω implementation, Legacy harvest and proof as evidence-bearing projections only where useful.
Keep the end vision and factory model as the anchor.
Do not reopen broad archaeology unless a graph contradiction exposes a genuinely material blind spot.
When the graph is sufficiently trustworthy, use it as the Steward's primary architecture-to-build map.
session_end_state: Preparation/readiness is GO; the destination architecture graph is now the key architectural instrument immediately before and during coding.
known_open_process_question: How much graph machinery is actually necessary? Prefer the smallest useful graph/query/view capability and let implementation needs justify expansion.
handoff_principle: The next session should preserve all accumulated intelligence, reduce rediscovery, and move toward real implementation rather than generating another documentation program.
